title: ML↔DEVOPS-001: ML Build Requirements + ML Build/CI Infrastructure (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED / PROVISIONAL — there is NO direct §6 contract on either the Edge AI/ML Engineer or the DevOps/Platform Engineer side (EDGE_AI_ML_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no DevOps; DEVOPS_PLATFORM_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no ML). Model build/deploy infrastructure and the ML CI pipeline are owned by MLOps: the training/conversion CI pipeline and registry come from ML↔MLOPS-001, and the underlying platform/cluster/IaC from MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001. This schema reconstructs the plausible direct interface (ML build requirements ↔ ML build/CI infrastructure) for machine validation; per its x-macp.source_status it mandates a COUNTER. A direct ML↔DevOps interaction should generally route through MLOps.

ml_build_requirements.description: ML→DEVOPS: training-environment / build / compute requirements (normally expressed to MLOps).

devops_ml_infrastructure.description: DEVOPS→ML: ML build infrastructure / CI capacity (provided via the MLOps layer).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Provisional/DERIVED edge — no §6 contract exists on either side, and the capability it describes is explicitly owned by MLOps: the ML CI/training pipeline is ML↔MLOPS-001 and the platform/cluster/IaC is MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001. Agents coordinate provisionally and must COUNTER, routing the real work through MLOps.
x-macp.source_status: DERIVED — no direct §6 on either the ML or DEVOPS side; the model build/deploy CI is owned by ML↔MLOPS-001 + MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001. Mandates COUNTER (CCR; normally route through MLOps), not a binding CONFIRM.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (provisional — to be set by the ratifying §6 contract / CCR)
confirm_conditions: ML build/compute requirements are expressed for the MLOps-owned pipeline (ML↔MLOPS-001)
no pipeline ownership is asserted directly between ML and DevOps
reject_conditions: ML build/CI infrastructure treated as a direct ML↔DevOps contract, bypassing the MLOps-owned pipeline (ML↔MLOPS-001 / MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001)
a compute quantity expressed ambiguously (no type/quantity) for provisioning
this DERIVED schema treated as a binding contract — it is provisional pending §6 ratification
counter_conditions: ALWAYS COUNTER: route ML build/deploy infrastructure through MLOps (ML↔MLOPS-001 → MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001), and request a CCR if a genuine direct ML↔DevOps need exists
a specialized compute/toolchain need exceeds standard provisioning — route through MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001 / RES↔DEVOPS-001 with the full spec
